filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 videos. For English, a diverse set of high-quality channels was chosen, including Mathsolves Zone, Gate Smashers, and MIT OCW. For Arabic, selections were dominated by highly-viewed, reputable academic channels like Dr. Ahmed Hagag and احمد علي احمد. The topic 'Double Summations and Index Shifting' in Arabic had no sufficiently relevant candidates, as the only available video was too introductory.
